# Temporary Telegram icon compatibility experiment

Unmodified notification.webp and ic_launcher_dr.webp resources from the official Telegram Android repository, commit f32ffeec763f0bdbf4bec25b52d654f77bff733d.

Source: https://github.com/DrKLO/Telegram/tree/f32ffeec763f0bdbf4bec25b52d654f77bff733d/TMessagesProj/src/main/res
Repository license: GNU GPL version 2; original license retained in LICENSE. Source resource hashes and dimensions are recorded in sources.json. The copies have diagnostic resource names; the binary images are unchanged.

These resources are used only for the user's temporary Android compatibility experiment. App name and package identity remain Volna/dev.volna.messenger. No Telegram package, account, API or message is impersonated. Web and Windows artwork is unaffected. Original Volna assets remain available for restoration after this test.
